name: netbox-mcp
description: NetBox source of truth for your assistant: the five-tool netbox MCP server plus the netbox-modeling skill that drives it. Model sites, racks, devices, modules, cables and IPAM without guessing a field name.

netbox_url.title: NetBox URL
netbox_url.description: Base URL of your NetBox instance, e.g. https://netbox.example.com — no /api suffix and no trailing path.

netbox_token.title: NetBox API token
netbox_token.description: NetBox → your user menu → API Tokens → Add a token. Leave 'Write enabled' unchecked unless the assistant is meant to change infrastructure records.
